parole.significato: -gen (a producer of something, or an agent in the production of something)
parole.testo: Borrowed from French -gène, from Ancient Greek -γενής (-genḗs).

parole.significato: herpetology (the branch of biology dealing with reptiles and amphibians)
parole.testo: From scientific French herpetologia, from Ancient Greek ἑρπετόν (herpetón, “reptile”). With -lógia (“suffix indicating a field of study or work”).
Borrowed from French collage (literally “gluing”), from coller (“to glue”), from Ancient Greek κόλλα (kólla, “glue”). With -ázs ending.
From French morphème, from Ancient Greek μορφή (morphḗ, “shape, form”).

parole.significato: nostalgia, homesickness (a longing for home or familiar surroundings)
parole.testo: From French nostalgie, from Ancient Greek νόστος (nóstos, “a return home”) + ἄλγος (álgos, “pain, suffering”).
